turns.question: How far through September 2026's ad budget did we get by the end of the month, as a share of the budget?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for total budget or share of budget used, so I cannot give that percentage; the closest metrics are remaining_budget_eur (EUR 4,130.00 left across campaigns at the end of September 2026, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) and ad_spend_eur. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
